title: Automations
description: The rules a hub runs by itself, as values: a button that runs one, a switch that turns one on or off, a light that shows one is running, and switches that pause them all or pause one group. Held by the hub itself. Only a rule a superuser approved can be run or turned on.

values.title: Run
values.description: Send true to run the rule now, as if one of its triggers had fired. Its condition is still checked.

values.title: On
values.description: True while the rule is on.

values.title: Running
values.description: True while the rule is in the middle of its steps.

values.title: Pause all
values.description: True stops every rule: none fires, and one in the middle of its steps stops there.

values.title: Pause group
values.description: True stops the rules of one group and leaves the rest running.
